environment: Production-built Web SPA in headless Microsoft Edge; local loopback static server; synthetic Company Co fixtures and intercepted API; external network and WebSockets blocked.
method: Authenticate as a synthetic superadmin frontend fixture. Exercise the Company list and create/edit/delete dialogs against an in-memory mock API. Verify exact create/update payloads, list readback of company fields and country labels, native delete confirmation, and fixture removal.

contracts: Create form submits name, industry and BR country code in the expected API payload.
The created Brazil country relation appears in the refreshed company list.
Edit form submits updated name, industry and BR/MX country codes in the expected API payload.
Updated company fields and Brazil/Mexico relations appear in the refreshed list.
Delete action requires and accepts the native confirmation, then submits the expected company ID.
The synthetic company is absent from the mock persistence and rendered list after deletion.

suite_result: 1 test passed, 0 failed; full services/web test:uat suite also passed (6 browser suites plus AI-admin).
provenance: Web UI and request-contract evidence only. API responses are mocked; this does not prove backend authentication, authorization, PostgreSQL persistence, or deployment.
